purpose: Teach: 最古/三振/高地/産学/海賊版/長け/ショールーム/師団

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界最古参の取引先との関係を維持しましょう
lines.en: Let's keep up our relationship with the longest-standing client in the industry.
lines.style: Gently proposing, careful and clear; a soft cooperative rise closing out the suggestion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。三振、つまり交渉の三振、三回連続失敗を避けましょう
lines.en: Right. And let's avoid a strikeout in the negotiations — three failed rounds in a row.
lines.style: Agreeable quick pickup; wry half-smile on the strikeout metaphor, easy collegial rhythm.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 高地、つまり高地拠点の物流を整えましょう
lines.en: Let's get the logistics in order for the highland site — our high-altitude base.
lines.style: Thinking aloud, measured; a small self-clarifying pause, then the plan laid out neatly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。産学、つまり産学連携のシンポジウムに出席します
lines.en: Right. I'll attend the symposium on industry-academia collaboration.
lines.style: Relaxed, dependable confirmation; slight forward energy on committing to attend.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 海賊版対策の弁護士を雇いましょう
lines.en: Let's bring in a lawyer to handle the pirated-goods problem.
lines.style: Firmer than her usual, still polite; quiet resolve pressing through the suggestion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経理に長けた社員を昇格させます
lines.en: Right. We'll promote the staff member who's so strong in accounting.
lines.style: Approving and unhurried; a warm note of respect on the colleague's skill.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ショールーム改装の見積を取りましょう
lines.en: Let's get a quote for the showroom renovation.
lines.style: Brisk wrap-up energy; light and efficient, ticking the item off the list aloud.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。防災で師団規模の演習に参加します
lines.en: Right. For disaster preparedness, we'll join a division-scale exercise.
lines.style: Steady closing confirmation; calm even pace, a settled done-for-the-day finality.
